verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל־ תַּ֭שְׁחֵת מִכְתָּ֑ם לְדָוִ֣ד בְּבָרְח֥וֹ מִפְּנֵי־ שָׁ֝א֗וּל בַּמְּעָרָֽה׃ חָנֵּ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ חָנֵּ֗נִי כִּ֥י בְךָ֮ נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י חָסָ֪יָה וּבְצֵֽל־ כְּנָפֶ֥יךָ אֶחְסֶ֑ה עַ֝֗ד הַוּֽוֹת׃ יַעֲבֹ֥ר
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ’al- taš·ḥêṯ miḵ·tām lə·ḏā·wiḏ bə·ḇā·rə·ḥōw mip·pə·nê·šā- šā·ʾûl bam·mə·‘ā·rāh ḥān·nê·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥān·nê·nî kî ḇə·ḵā nap̄·šî ḥā·sā·yāh ū·ḇə·ṣêl- kə·nā·p̄e·ḵā ’eḥ·seh ‘aḏ haw·wō·wṯ ya·‘ă·ḇōr
verses.literal: For the choirmaster. [To the tune of] vvv Do Not Destroy A Miktam of David when he fled from Saul into the cave Have mercy on me O God have mercy for in You my soul takes refuge In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed

verses.original: אֶ֭קְרָא לֵֽאלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן לָ֝אֵ֗ל גֹּמֵ֥ר עָלָֽי׃
verses.literal: I cry out to God Most High to God who fulfills His purpose for me

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֤ח מִשָּׁמַ֨יִם׀ וְֽיוֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי חֵרֵ֣ף שֹׁאֲפִ֣י סֶ֑לָה אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יִשְׁלַ֥ח חַסְדּ֥וֹ וַאֲמִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·laḥ miš·šā·ma·yim wə·yō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî ḥê·rêp̄ šō·’ă·p̄î se·lāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm yiš·laḥ ḥas·dōw wa·’ă·mit·tōw
verses.literal: He reaches down from heaven and saves me He rebukes those who trample me Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֤י׀ בְּת֥וֹךְ לְבָאִם֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה לֹ֫הֲטִ֥ים בְּֽנֵי־ אָדָ֗ם שִׁ֭נֵּיהֶם חֲנִ֣ית וְחִצִּ֑ים וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם חַדָּֽה׃ חֶ֣רֶב
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šî bə·ṯō·wḵ lə·ḇā·’im ’eš·kə·ḇāh lō·hă·ṭîm bə·nê- ’ā·ḏām šin·nê·hem ḥă·nîṯ wə·ḥiṣ·ṣîm ū·lə·šō·w·nām ḥad·dāh ḥe·reḇ
verses.literal: My soul [is] among the lions I lie down with ravenous beasts . . . [with] men whose teeth are spears and arrows whose tongues are sharp swords

verses.original: ר֣וּמָה אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַל־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃ עַ֖ל כָּל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ
verses.literal: Be exalted O God above the heavens may Your glory cover all the earth

verses.original: הֵכִ֣ינוּ רֶ֤שֶׁת׀ לִפְעָמַי֮ נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י כָּפַ֪ף כָּר֣וּ שִׁיחָ֑ה לְפָנַ֣י נָפְל֖וּ בְתוֹכָ֣הּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: hê·ḵî·nū re·šeṯ lip̄·‘ā·may nap̄·šî kā·p̄ap̄ kā·rū šî·ḥāh lə·p̄ā·nay nā·p̄ə·lū ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵāh se·lāh
verses.literal: They spread a net for my feet my soul was despondent They dug a pit before me but they themselves have fallen into it Selah

verses.original: לִבִּ֣י נָ֘כ֤וֹן אֱ֭לֹהִים לִבִּ֑י נָכ֣וֹן אָ֝שִׁ֗ירָה וַאֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃
verses.literal: My heart is steadfast O God my heart is steadfast I will sing and make music

verses.original: ע֤וּרָה כְבוֹדִ֗י ע֭וּרָֽה הַנֵּ֥בֶל וְכִנּ֗וֹר אָעִ֥ירָה שָּֽׁחַר׃
verses.literal: Awake my glory Awake O harp and lyre I will awaken the dawn

verses.original: אוֹדְךָ֖ אֲדֹנָ֑י בָעַמִּ֥ים׀ אֲ֝זַמֶּרְךָ֗ בַּל־ אֻמִּֽים׃
verses.literal: I will praise You O Lord among the nations I will sing Your praises . . . among the peoples

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ גָדֹ֣ל עַד־ שָׁמַ֣יִם וְֽעַד־ אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃ שְׁחָקִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥas·de·ḵā ḡā·ḏōl ‘aḏ- šā·ma·yim wə·‘aḏ- ’ă·mit·te·ḵā šə·ḥā·qîm
verses.literal: For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens and Your faithfulness to the clouds

verses.original: ר֣וּמָה אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַל־ שָׁמַ֣יִם כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃ עַ֖ל כָּל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ
verses.literal: Be exalted O God above the heavens may Your glory cover all the earth
